posts.title: Knowember 2026
posts.description: Knowember is another little blogging challenge by Robert Birming. It’s all about learning more about the people behind the personal blogs. To quote him: The idea is simple: one page to let others know a bit more about yourself. So if you also have a blog, please participate too! posts.title: A second attempt
posts.description: This past Sunday, I ran my second ever marathon. Just like last year, it was in Lausanne. I’m happy to report that I not only started for the second time, but also finished it for the second time. And I improved my PB by over 5 minutes, from last year’s 4:18:01 to 4:12:25. posts.description: A couple of weeks ago, I was quite certain that my next phone would be the iPhone 18.
